name: Lazy K's Campground and Canoe Livery
note: Family-run campground on 70 acres along the Elk River near Elkview, about 12 miles from Charleston; shaded 50-amp full-hookup RV sites in the woods, primitive tent sites along the river, cabins, canoe livery. Reservations by phone. RV sites $45 or $55 per night (weekly $270/$330, monthly $700 incl. utilities) for 2 adults + 2 children. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$48/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.5 over 116 reviews. --Claude

name: Smokey Bottom Campground
note: Full-hookup campground minutes from Elkins and the Monongahela National Forest; every RV site has city water, 30/50-amp electric, sewer and Wi-Fi, with a row of creekside sites along the west edge; cabins too. RV $50/night for four ($45/night past 7 nights), creekside sites +$10; monthly $650-750 incl. utilities; limited seasonal sites. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$45/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.4 over 87 reviews. --Claude

name: Camp Holly
note: Fishing campground and cabin retreat near Diana in Webster County; a tree-lined creekside lane of full-hookup 30-amp RV sites (#4-10), riverside tent sites, a stocked fishing pond, cabins and glamping, bathhouse; seasonal RV sites too. Booked on Campspot: RV site fitting 45 ft $49.35/night (October 2026 and June 2027 quotes). RV Life 5*/$$$ ~$50/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.6 over 69 reviews. --Claude

name: Kick Back N Camp
note: Campground near Belington (Barbour County) with gravel pull-through spurs beside a fishing pond; wooded primitive and electric tent sites, RV sites with water + electric or full hookups; Belington Round Up car show in June. Reservable online. Nightly + tax: W/E RV $40, FHU $45, premium FHU $50, wooded RV/tent with electric $35. RV Life 5*/$$$ ~$41/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.9 over 326 reviews. --Claude

name: Lost River Campground

name: River Ridge Campground
note: Small riverfront campground on a bend of the Greenbrier River near Alderson; about 13 full-hookup sites (20/30/50-amp), averaging 50x20 ft, all on the river, owners live on site. Reservable online; 14-night maximum, 2-night minimum on weekends. Sun-Thu $46, Fri-Sat $49, holidays $53, for up to 4 people + tax. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$45/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.3 over 53 reviews. --Claude

name: Princess Snowbird Campground
note: One of Yokum's Vacationland's two campgrounds at Seneca Rocks, across the road from the Rocks and bordering Seneca Creek; RV hookup sites, tent and electric pop-up sites, teepees and bunkhouses; open all winter. No reservations for camping (first come, first served). RV camping $50 for 1-4 people, electric tent/pop-up $40, tents $12/person. Unrated on RV Life; Google 4.7 over 10 reviews, and Yokum's Vacationland as a whole 4.6 over 569. --Claude

name: Ashland Resort
note: ATV resort at Northfork in McDowell County on the Hatfield-McCoy Pocahontas trail system; about 96 sites along the hollow roads - 30-amp water/electric back-ins, 30/50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs and back-ins, tent sites - plus cabins, lodges and cottages.
